decisions.rationale: Lymphangioma does not match the clinical and histological features described in the vignette.
Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma (Dabska tumor) is a distinct entity with different characteristics.
Benign lymphangioendothelioma (BLAE) does not align with the provided clinical and histological findings.
Pseudo-Kaposi’s sarcoma (acroangiodermatitis) has different clinical and histological features.
